name: Reality Fracture
notes: Ten two-color archetypes: ally pairs follow Hexhaven’s colleges, enemy pairs follow major characters.
Empower Jace adds loyalty to one Jace token that surveils or draws cards.
Heartwood tokens are mana artifacts that let red-green ramp early.

archetypes.name: Fatehold surveil
archetypes.plan: Scry and surveil to set up draws.
archetypes.detail: Payoffs reward a library you have sorted.

archetypes.name: Theorix graveyard
archetypes.plan: Reach seven cards in your graveyard.
archetypes.detail: Self-mill and cheap spells turn on threshold payoffs.

archetypes.name: Stingerquill burn
archetypes.detail: Burn doubles as removal and enables Stingerquill payoffs.

archetypes.name: Konstrari ramp
archetypes.detail: Cast your biggest creatures ahead of schedule.

archetypes.name: Vigorbloom life gain
archetypes.detail: Payoffs want life gain and +1/+1 counters together.

archetypes.name: Chandra’s prowess
archetypes.detail: Spell triggers and bounce keep the board clear.

archetypes.name: Garruk’s bestiary
archetypes.detail: Return the ones that die for more.

archetypes.name: Ajani’s army
archetypes.detail: +1/+1 counters and Equipment speed up the clock.

archetypes.name: Jace’s mastery
archetypes.detail: Keep drawing value from it all game.

mechanics.name: Empower Jace
mechanics.text: Put loyalty counters on your Jace token, creating one first if needed. It can surveil 1 or draw a card.

mechanics.name: Heartwood
mechanics.text: A red and green artifact token that taps for red or green mana.

mechanics.name: Prepare
mechanics.text: A prepared creature lets you cast a copy of its attached spell; doing so unprepares it.

mechanics.name: Flashback
mechanics.text: Cast the instant or sorcery from your graveyard for its flashback cost, then exile it.
